sources.evidence: Exact model and only listed snapshot gpt-realtime-2.1; 128000 context and 32000 output tokens; text/audio/image input and text/audio output; configurable reasoning and function calling. sources.title: OpenAI API changelog
sources.evidence: July 6, 2026 explicitly releases GPT-Realtime-2.1 and the separate distilled mini model. May 7 launches its predecessor GPT-Realtime-2. No count or neural topology is supplied. Fresh HTTP-200 Markdown reread October 27 at 17:14 UTC: the July 6 distillation statement belongs to 2.1-mini, not the full 2.1 model.

sources.title: New Realtime models on the API
sources.evidence: July 6 announcement corroborates the exact release, speech-to-speech reasoning, function use and improved alphanumeric recognition, noise/silence and interruptions. Its caching latency improvement is an infrastructure result, not a parameter or topology disclosure. User replies are not used as specification evidence. Reopened October 27: explicitly calls full 2.1 an update of Realtime-2, without a numerical size or another named base checkpoint.

name.note: Exact official display name and undated identifier; no dated snapshot is listed.

family.note: Use the documented GPT-Realtime product series instead of the generic gpt label. This is a catalog grouping, not an inference of shared weights with GPT-Realtime-2 or GPT-4o.

release_date.note: Exact first public API release in the changelog; not the predecessor May 7 launch or the separate GPT-Live July 8 release.

open_weights.note: Released as hosted Realtime API access; no weight distribution is offered in the official model inventory.

license.note: Descriptive classification of hosted service distribution under retained IP, not an SPDX model-weight license.

parameters_b.note: Fresh October 27 re-audit found no published nominal total in the reopened exact-model reference, release or original announcement. OpenAI explicitly calls 2.1 an update of GPT-Realtime-2, but the predecessor reference and launch supply no numerical size to inherit; GPT-5-class reasoning is not a named base checkpoint. The mini distillation statement applies to a separate model. Targeted total/billion, active/activated and later technical-report searches, plus later OpenAI voice cards and NVIDIA VoiceChat comparisons, supplied no exact 2.1 count. Null reflects missing nominal evidence, not a demand for an exact tensor census.

active_parameters_b.note: Separately searched active/activated counts on October 27. No exact 2.1 active-count statement or explicit activated-parameter comparison was found. The named Realtime-2 predecessor has no published active size; later Live cards report safety scores, and NVIDIA VoiceChat tables report generic Realtime performance without exact 2.1 identity or a parameter column. No active count is inferred from total size, density, latency, caching or the separate Live backend.

architecture.note: Exact model topology remains unverified after primary training/engineering/interpretability searches and later voice-card checks. Direct speech processing is established, but Transformer, dense/MoE and encoder/decoder dimensions are not. GPT-Live full-duplex/delegation and generic cache explanations do not establish this model’s structure; GPT naming alone is insufficient.

context_window.note: Exact documented total token window. The 32000 output limit is separate; do not replace 128000 with binary 131072.

modalities.note: Native text/audio/image inputs and text/audio outputs are explicitly documented. No video or independent PDF modality is asserted. Audio responses may include transcript text; the API selects an audio or text response mode.

reasoning.note: The exact model supports reasoning tokens and configurable effort. No exact default or effort enumeration is inferred from the older Realtime-2 prompting guide or forum-user configuration.

tool_call.note: Function calling is explicitly supported through Realtime sessions; the host executes function calls. Responses and Chat Completions are not supported endpoints for this exact model.

patch.notes: Released July 6, 2026 as gpt-realtime-2.1; the only documented snapshot is the undated identifier. Realtime API only, with 128000-token context and 32000 maximum output. Text/audio/image input, text/audio output, configurable reasoning and function calling are documented. Total and active sizes remain undisclosed in the checked sources; the explicitly named predecessor GPT-Realtime-2 also has no published count to inherit. Neural architecture remains unverified. GPT-Live and its delegated backend are separate models.

summary: October 27 parameter re-audit preserves both counts as undisclosed after fresh exact-model documentation, explicit Realtime-2 update-lineage checks and later OpenAI/NVIDIA voice comparisons. The named predecessor has no published nominal size, and no exact 2.1 activated-parameter convention was found. Added explicit null count patches and null parameters_source; the other twelve field assessments are unchanged.
